svg.title: Methylene blue: what has actually been tested
svg.desc: Methylene blue: what has actually been tested. Approved medical use: Hospital IV drug for acquired methemoglobinemia (FDA brand 2016, plus 7 generics). Verdict: Approved. Alzheimer's (TauRx's LMTM/HMTM): Three phase 3 trials, 2,289 people: main goals not met as designed. Verdict: Not proven. Memory in healthy adults: One single-dose brain-scan study in 26 people. Verdict: Very early. Mood, PTSD, phobia: Three small trials of 37 to 42 people, mixed results. Verdict: Preliminary. Mitochondria, longevity, anti-aging: Lab and animal work; we found no human anti-aging trial. Verdict: Not tested in people. Safety: Boxed warning: serotonin syndrome with SSRIs and other drugs; G6PD; pregnancy. Verdict: Serious risks. Oral "supplement" products: No FDA-approved oral product; Australia: imports not assessed for quality. Verdict: Unreviewed.
